A white dwarf, §bcooled into a black dwarf§r.

§e§lUNLOCK§r The T4 milestones, then:
- put the §bSubspace Cooling Core§r in escrow;
- build the §bsecond arms§r (stack 5: 5,065 Galactic Shell Plating);
- bring compression to 5;
- put §bStar Chart: Sirius B§r in the slot. The neutron star goes out, because there is one star per Eye.
§bFirst Cooling§r is one batch with a mean yield of at least 0.9 and no fracture.

§e§lBATCHES§r Each batch takes §b18,432 L WDM§r and assembles a white dwarf at Θ +90. Over §b2 h§r (÷ the dial) the cooling setpoint ramps from §b+90 to −90§r, and you keep Θ on the curve: at T5 the gauge reads your error from the setpoint. The output is §b4,608 L Black Dwarf Matter × the batch's mean yield§r.

§e§lSUBSPACE COOLING§r
- Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid (100 L) is the heat sink: Θ −1, P −0.5.
- Raw Star Matter (1,000 L) reheats an overshoot: Θ +3.
- Helium (1,000 L) is accretion pressure: P +2.
Expect about §b100,000 L DSSF a batch§r. Decay heat pushes Θ up the whole way, and crystallisation drags P down.

§e§lTHE PLATEAU§r While the setpoint crosses −10..+10 (about 800 s), latent heat adds §bΘ +0.15 a second§r. The event channel warns 15 s ahead.

[warn]§lFracture§r (Breach or Integrity 0): the batch ends and yields 25 % × the fraction done.[/warn]

[note]One T4 Eye on the default feed makes exactly enough WDM for one T5 Eye.[/note]

§a§lDONE WHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
